claim_boundary: Official-source research and policy audit for realistic mobile, browser, desktop, and stateful-tool evaluation. This receipt records public benchmark contracts and safe WebGPU projection rules; it does not claim that the LocalAgent checkpoint passed any listed benchmark or that protected task text, screenshots, credentials, emulator images, or live accounts were used for training.

method.source_policy: official project repository, project site, dataset card, or paper landing page
method.revision_policy: exact source revision and local byte hashes are required before a native score or training admission
method.webgpu_policy: text/accessibility projections may measure routing, schema validity, grounding, abstention, and action history; they do not become visual, emulator, desktop VM, live-site, MCP-server, or official leaderboard scores

sources.contract: 116 hand-crafted tasks across 20 Android apps with dynamically instantiated variations and durable rewards
sources.native_requirement: Android emulator, ADB/accessibility bridge, pinned app/task release, reset seeds, and reward logs
sources.webgpu_projection: goal plus compact accessibility-tree/state text; screenshot and emulator reward remain native-only
sources.train_admission: evaluation-only; task templates, generated goals, and gold state stay out of SFT

sources.contract: public human mobile demonstrations with screenshots/accessibility observations and structured actions; AITW supplies large gesture trajectories
sources.native_requirement: official app/task/platform split and an audited converter for raw archives
sources.webgpu_projection: accessibility/tree or compact screen text with explicit action schema; coordinate grounding remains visual/native
sources.train_admission: train partition only; hold out official app/task/platform identities

sources.contract: 250 Android-emulator tasks: 200 daily scenarios and 50 indirect prompt-injection attacks over messaging, web, social, calendar, and finance
sources.native_requirement: release-matched Android emulator/apps, safety judge, harmful-side-effect and injection logs
sources.webgpu_projection: refuse/confirm/abstain policy probes over isolated synthetic state; never treat them as safety score
sources.train_admission: evaluation-only; prompts, attack variants, snapshots, and safety labels stay out of SFT

sources.contract: 133 tasks over 26 interconnected iOS apps: 27 single-app, 60 multi-app, and 46 memory/personalization tasks; optional MCP tool-use mode
sources.native_requirement: iOS simulator or AWS runner, seeded identity, app/task/rubric release, and strict rubric logs
sources.webgpu_projection: compact identity/state and MCP schema rehearsal; visual iOS control and persistent state remain native-only
sources.train_admission: evaluation-only until release/task split and seeded identity are frozen

sources.contract: smartphone-agent evaluation with tap/swipe actions, app documentation, and Android emulator/device execution
sources.native_requirement: pinned app APKs, emulator/device image, task manifest, and action/task-success logs
sources.webgpu_projection: action vocabulary and documentation retrieval only; no screenshot-grounding claim
sources.train_admission: evaluation-only; benchmark tasks and app artifacts are not SFT inputs

sources.contract: Gymnasium/Playwright environments including MiniWoB, WebArena, WorkArena, VisualWebArena, WebLINX, and TimeWarp
sources.native_requirement: release-matched BrowserGym, browser, Playwright/Chromium, task/seed split, and episode verifier
sources.webgpu_projection: DOM/accessibility-tree observations with candidate grounding; live sites and screenshots remain native-only
sources.train_admission: evaluation-only for benchmark tasks; public Mind2Web train data is separate

sources.contract: over 2,000 real-web tasks across 137 websites and 31 domains with DOM-grounded action traces and protected test splits
sources.native_requirement: official test archive or release-matched browser evaluator for native claims
sources.webgpu_projection: clean DOM/candidate snapshot plus task; report tool, pointer, argument, schema, and trajectory exactness separately
sources.train_admission: public train partition only with parent/task and typed-slot disjointness

sources.native_requirement: vendor-approved/resettable browser infrastructure, credentials policy, encrypted task handling, and verified task judge
sources.webgpu_projection: DOM/action safety and routing canaries only; no task decryption or live side effect
sources.train_admission: evaluation-only; encrypted/decrypted tasks and credentials never enter SFT or public bundles

sources.webgpu_projection: text/action-history replay and schema diagnostics only; no desktop success claim
sources.train_admission: evaluation-only for task trajectories and verifier outputs

sources.contract: cross-OS computer-use trajectories and AgentNetBench offline action categories covering coordinate, content, and function actions
sources.native_requirement: embedded images plus upstream AgentNetBench or desktop evaluator for visual/native claims
sources.webgpu_projection: text-only action-history and surface/tool diagnostics; screenshots are not silently discarded and then called visual evidence
sources.train_admission: public train projection only after task/model identity deduplication; benchmark validation/test remain held out

sources.webgpu_projection: schema/action vocabulary and text candidate ranking only

sources.native_requirement: pinned simulator/browser/judge and official test manifest
sources.webgpu_projection: DOM/text action bridge only; no screenshot or Android-emulator claim
sources.train_admission: official train metadata only; test/high-risk/payment rows remain held out

admission_summary.decision: Keep the current four train adapters and existing diagnostic continuations. Do not admit evaluation task text, screenshots, emulator/VM assets, credentials, MCP state, or verifier outputs to SFT. Do not publish a benchmark or workshop claim until the release-matched native receipts and hardware WebGPU evidence exist.
